description:
C3 2023 WINTER SUBMISSION

The hostile chicken enemy from The Legend of Zelda series. You may remember it from Aeron's Golden Cookie Quest, where inputting the Konami code at Setsuma VIllage summons a barrage of mean chickens. Uses vanilla palette.

Use it with any sprite you see fit.

Dark Prince reshaded this No Body the Dragon graphics at my request (it is me, Anorakun).

Please credit Dark Prince and NBTD if using this graphic.
